The Haber Reactor makes Ammonia, a gas, from Hydrogen and Nitrogen over a hot catalyst:
- 60 mB Hydrogen + 20 mB Nitrogen make 40 mB Ammonia every second.
- It uses 60 FE/t and 10 HU/t, and only works at 450°C or hotter. Below that it waits, keeping its progress.
# Setting up
- Heat: a Fuel Burner or a Firebox against its heat face (the bottom, by default). It holds heat up to 800°C.
- Gases: pipe Hydrogen (from an Electrolyzer) and Nitrogen (from an Air Separator) into its input faces (the top and left). Each gas keeps a tank of its own.
- Ammonia leaves through its Gas Output face (the right) every tick.
Ammonia goes into the Chemical Reactor to make NPK Fertilizer. Speed and Energy upgrades work.
